description:
Found while fixing bedrock-q67.36 (PR #249). Two handlers in lib/bedrock/data_plane/commit_proxy/server.ex reply while mode == :running without returning through noreply_resuming_cadence/1, so the GenServer timeout that drives the empty-transaction heartbeat and batch finalization is not re-armed:

1. handle_call({:commit, _epoch, ...}, _from, %{mode: :running}) -> {:error, :wrong_epoch} (server.ex:184 at the time of filing)
2. the handle_info(_msg, t) catch-all (server.ex:333)

With an OPEN batch, either path strands the batch and every caller blocked on it until the next unrelated message arrives — worse than the q67.36 defect (which only delayed the first heartbeat). Same class of fix as #249: reply and return through the cadence-resuming shape. Reproduce the way #249's recovery_heartbeat_test.exs pins the direct-handler return ({:noreply, _, timeout}) and add a live test with an open batch.
title: Commit proxy replies in :running mode without re-arming the heartbeat: wrong_epoch commit and handle_info catch-all strand an open batch
